Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision sustained while the vehicle was turning left, with a reported impact to the head. Symptoms
and mechanism are consistent with a concussion, and the reported force of the crash is in keeping with the injury described. Over
the course of care the patient attended fourteen visits, a somewhat longer course than is typical for an injury of this type, with
symptom management, graded activity, and vestibular and cognitive monitoring provided at each stage. Several examination
findings support the diagnosis, including reported headache, light sensitivity, and deficits on the symptom checklist, while other
testing, including neurological screening and imaging where performed, returned normal results. No prior injury to the head or
neck region is known from the patient history. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated
or repeated entries. Current status shows gradual improvement, and ongoing follow-up is recommended to monitor recovery and
return to usual activities.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
